notes: Region4L.gdb-style older files are not online; keep if needed. The statewide MapServer answers queries without geometry, so fetch layers use the regional FeatureServers (Regions 4, 8 and 9; the other regions have matching services). Use designations are in each regional service's WB_BenUses table (join on wbf_id); fetched layers carry the waterbodies only.
